title: All phases and amplitudes of every prescribed-polarization frequency triangle
statement: For every noncollinear resonant frequency trianglek3=k1+k2 with prescribed U(k)=i*conjugate(k)^3, P0 obeys the compatible QC inequality for all three wave amplitudes, phases and background means. Zero amplitudes follow by continuity; collinear characteristic fields are safe by rank-one Jensen. The review reconstructs the actual determinant and sign conversions while retaining the inherited nonnegative Schur diagonal blocks. Nonzero cubic moments/correlation are allowed. Arbitrary output polarizations and general multimode fields remain unresolved.
